emails.body:
Hi Nora,

Thanks for renewing with us! A few things change with your November 2026 rent:

1. Per the renewal you signed on Oct 15, monthly rent is now $2,240.00.
2. Management of your building moved from Brightwater Property Mgmt to Brightwater Residential LLC. The old BPM-7731 payee account stops accepting payments on Nov 1 - payments sent there will be returned.
3. Please add a new bill-pay payee: 'Brightwater Residential LLC', resident account BRL-20417.

Rent is still due on the 20th. You can verify all of this on page 1 of your signed renewal.

Best,
Brightwater Leasing Office
